one_line: A ceremonial melee sword that, when you strike a living human, triggers a public announced 15-30 second execution ritual that decapitates the victim if the channel completes.
player_facing_mechanics: Attack a living human with a mind (not yourself) to start an execution instead of a normal hit
A server-wide announcement names the attacker, victim, location and faction, and plays an announcer notice sound
A countdown/do_after channel of configurable length (15s base, 30s syndicate, 20s admin, or 30s for antag) during which the attacker must stay in range of the victim
On success the target's head bodypart is dismembered and a follow-up announcement confirms the execution in the faction's name
On failure the execution aborts, a failure sound plays, and an announcement declares the attacker brought shame to the faction
3 minute internal cooldown, shown to the user in rounded minutes when they try again too soon
Freeform faction/entity name entry via a TGUI text input on use-in-hand (only for variants with can_change_faction)
Examine text tells the user an input exists on the hilt to rename the faction (only when can_change_faction)
Suicide with the sword announces the user taking their own life in the faction's name and dismembers their own head
Antag variant plays one of a random list of three nasheed songs during the execution (localized sound channel)
Admin variant plays one of two songs broadcast to the entire world and lets admin pick the faction
Ends early / refunds nothing if target already dead, headless, or attacking a non-human / mindless mob (falls through to normal attack)
tg_systems_used: item melee/combat (attack override, force, sharpness, attack verbs, hitsound)
data_only_parts: Base item stats: name, desc, icons (icon, icon_state, inhand_icon_state, lefthand_file, righthand_file), force, throwforce, sharpness, attack_verb_continuous/simple, hitsound, w_class
Default execution_faction string, can_change_faction flag, execution_time, and the EXECUTION_COOLDOWN_TIME / SOUND_VOLUME defines
antag subtype data: execution_faction "The Syndicate", can_change_faction TRUE, execution_time 30 SECONDS, execution_songs osts
admin subtype data: execution_faction "Centcom", can_change_faction TRUE, execution_time 20 SECONDS, execution_songs list
logic_parts: attack() gating: ishuman + has mind + not self + has head + not dead + cooldown ready, else fall back to normal attack
cooldown check with human-readable remaining-minutes message
the do_after execution channel and success/failure branches (dismember on success only)
minor_announce start/success/failure messages and sound override flag
play_execution_music / stop_execution_music per-variant (no-op, local playsound with listeners list, world-broadcast SEND_SOUND)
tgui_input_text faction renaming plus message_admins audit log
byond_specific: message_admins / ADMIN_LOOKUPFLW admin logging with follow links
BYOND string templates / span macros and p_their()/p_theyre() pronouns
port_notes: Maps cleanly to an ExecutionSwordComponent + ExecutionSwordSystem: intercept the melee hit event to branch into a DoAfter channel (with target head/dismember check via a Body/dismember system), then fire an announcer event on start/success/failure and apply dismember on success. The 3-minute cooldown becomes a held-item cooldown/action timer with a user popup; faction renaming maps to a UI BoundUserInterface or a simple verb/action opening a text field (SS14 has no direct tgui_input_text, so it needs a BUI window or an admin/verb path). Antag/admin song playback is the friction point: local playsound can map to AudioSystem/predicted sound entities, but the admin variant's SEND_SOUND(world,...) global broadcast has no direct SS14 analogue and needs a design decision (global audio entity vs. server-wide announcement only). Open questions: should the execution be an item component or a gamerule/antag ability, should the mechanic be tradable/stealable as a plain item, and how to expose the admin-only variant and world-music behaviour in the SS14 admin tooling.
